comment: Pinned model weights for services/perception. scripts/fetch_weights.py downloads each file and refuses any whose sha256 differs. Entries with sha256=null are not pinned yet: run `python scripts/fetch_weights.py --pin` once (HF_TOKEN needed for the gated SAM 3 repo), review, and commit the digests. The Docker build runs fetch_weights.py --require-pinned, so an unpinned lock cannot produce an image. model_hash (§6.0) = sha256 over these digests + the canonical SETTINGS blob (perception/settings.py).
